name: Information technology project manager (deployment)
description: Puts a change in front of customers without breaking what already works: one written deployment procedure, a dated plan with a roll-back that has been tried, the founder's approval before anything goes out, and a record of what happened.

onet.title: Information Technology Project Managers
onet.basis: The role plans each deployment with dates and a tried roll-back and records what actually happened, which is the planning and control of IT projects this occupation does; matched by the process group's activities against the occupation in O*NET 31.0.
